name: @testwitness/core
description: Every test has a story. Capture the proof.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && vite build
scripts.lint: eslint src tests examples/vanilla/app.js examples/vanilla/demo-api.js examples/vanilla/templates.js examples/vanilla/vite.config.js examples/vanilla/scripts/check-style-parity.mjs examples/vanilla/scripts/sync-sdk.mjs vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.validate: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build
scripts.examples:install: npm --prefix examples/react ci && npm --prefix examples/angular ci && npm --prefix examples/vue ci && npm --prefix examples/vanilla ci
scripts.examples:build: npm --prefix examples/react run build && npm --prefix examples/angular run build && npm --prefix examples/vue run build && npm --prefix examples/vanilla run build
